sections.title: 1,000 Subscribers and Giveaway Announcement
sections.body:
We reached 1,000 subscribers!

Thank you for being here with Northbank Paper and supporting independent makers of all kinds. To celebrate this milestone, we’re running a giveaway.

Whether you’ve been with us since the first newsletter or just signed up, this one’s for you.

[CONFIRM: giveaway details, prizes, and how to enter]

Appreciate every single one of you.
